title: Bias Is a Subspace, Not a Coordinate: A Geometric Rethinking of Post-hoc Debiasing in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Training linear classifiers to probe for gender in image embeddings; evaluating demographic parity gaps in zero-shot classification; computing demographic skew in image retrieval for gender-neutral queries; and measuring gender mismatch rates and generation skew for professional prompts using an automated VQA model (BLIP-2).

Training logistic regression probes to predict race from image embeddings; measuring the demographic disparity in per-class recall across different skin tone groups in zero-shot classification using the FACET benchmark.

Training logistic regression probes on image embeddings to predict 9-class age categories; evaluating differences in zero-shot classification accuracy across age demographic groups using the FACET benchmark.
